_pre_score_comment: Hard trend thresholds applied before GPT — stocks failing any are dropped without an AI call. null = no limit for that direction.
_limit_order_comment: Caps buy price at pre-flight quote + buffer% for both paper and live (e.g. 0.5 = 0.5% above). null = market orders.
_bracket_comment: Stop-loss fires at -stop_loss_pct% below fill price. take_profit_pct locks in gains at +take_profit_pct%. Set either to null to disable.
_enhanced_data_comment: Each source can be independently disabled (e.g. if a scraper starts getting blocked) without a code change. max_tickers bounds worst-case wall-clock time since these are synchronous scrapers with no per-ticker concurrency.
_trailing_stop_by_risk_comment: When enabled, overrides the flat trailing_stop_pct above with a per-pick stop width keyed by GPT's risk (1-5): tighter for high-risk picks (cut losers faster) and wider for low-risk/high-conviction picks (let winners run), instead of stopping every position out at the same distance regardless of how risky it was flagged. Falls back to trailing_stop_pct for any risk value not listed. Only takes effect when trailing_stop_pct is set (same mutual-exclusivity rule as before).
_catalyst_type_weights_comment: Conviction/allocation multiplier applied per catalyst_type (1.0 = neutral). Derived from scripts/analyze_scoring.py's win-rate/return breakdown of 390 historical picks (keyword-classified pre-catalyst_type era): ma_acquisition was the worst performer (22.6% win rate, -30% total return contributed over 31 picks) so it is discounted; analyst_action was the best performer (54.1% win rate, +36.7% total return over 74 picks) despite catalyst_prompt.txt's WEAK CATALYST RULE treating it as a soft catalyst, so it is boosted. fda_approval and short_squeeze are the classic explosive-outlier catalysts and are kept neutral (1.0) rather than discounted -- fda_approval's historical -0.85x came from only 3 samples (too small to trust, and directly opposite the goal of catching big binary-event moves) and short_squeeze has 0 historical samples. Revisit all of these once enough native (post-catalyst_type-field) data accumulates -- run scripts/analyze_scoring.py periodically and adjust.
_risk_penalty_comment: Allocation penalty for risk>=threshold picks (applied as score * factor before score^2 weighting). Historically risk=3 picks had the HIGHEST total return of any risk bucket (95 picks, +47.5% total) -- possibly a small-sample artifact, but the penalty is kept configurable rather than hardcoded so it can be disabled/tuned as scripts/analyze_scoring.py accumulates more data without a code change.
